stops.text: 2 FLASHING LIGHTS · A Falling with headlights off — “I heard a / scream for help”
2 FLASHING LIGHTS · B Eyes dilate — “an emergency call / while tossing & turning—”
2 FLASHING LIGHTS · C Car pulls up — “Heart break revisits / an old scene.”
2 FLASHING LIGHTS · D The ghost child — “the ghost of a dead / & a love-less / seven-year old child”
2 FLASHING LIGHTS · E Parents arguing in the car — “a child is left / home alone”
2 FLASHING LIGHTS · F Tambourine through the window — “and no tears”
